entities.name: Darkslick
entities.description: A boundary region on New Phyrexia where the Surgical Bay's quicksilver seeps into the Dross Pits; home to laboratories and breeding vats.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Mirrodin became after its complete transformation.

entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: Fifth sphere region of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: Sixth sphere region of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Source of black necrogenous sludge that mingled with the Quicksilver Sea.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: Sentient sea with chrome-forged islands, mingling with the Mephidross at the Darkslick.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event preceding the completion of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: Machine served by the Darkslick's laboratories.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane that was completely transformed into New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Early Phyrexian agents, especially nim and vedalken, use the Darkslick for experiments unbound by ethical limits.
events.quote: Early Phyrexian agents, especially nim and vedalken, found the Darkslick ideal for experiments unbound by ethical limits.

events.summary: After Mirrodin's complete transformation into New Phyrexia, the Darkslick is absorbed into the plane's inner structure as a transition between the Surgical Bay and the Dross Pits.
events.quote: the region was absorbed into the inner structure of the plane

relations.quote: The Darkslick is a boundary region on the plane of New Phyrexia
Its laboratories now serve the Progress Engine
